results.sql: SELECT SUM((fs.gross_amount - fs.discount_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.sales_date = dd.date JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id JOIN fx_rate fx ON fs.sales_date = fx.rate_date AND fs.currency = fx.currency WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 2025 AND dd.fiscal_month = 1 AND ds.region_name = 'Dél-Alföld' AND fs.is_return = FALSE AND fs.is_cancelled = FALSE AND ds.is_test_store = FALSE
assumptions: March 2025 corresponds to fiscal_month 1 of fiscal_year 2025 (fiscal year starts on March 1)
Net sales is calculated as gross_amount minus discount_amount
Returns (is_return = TRUE) and cancelled receipts (is_cancelled = TRUE) are excluded from net sales
Test stores are excluded from the calculation
Currency conversion uses the fx_rate table with the sales_date and currency from each transaction
The region name 'Dél-Alföld' is spelled exactly as stored in the database

results.sql: SELECT SUM((fs.gross_amount - fs.discount_amount) / fr.eur_rate) AS net_revenue_eur FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.sales_date = dd.date LEFT JOIN fx_rate fr ON fs.sales_date = fr.rate_date AND fs.currency = fr.currency WHERE ds.region_name = 'Dél-Alföld' AND dd.fiscal_year = 2025 AND dd.fiscal_month = 1 AND fs.is_return = FALSE AND fs.is_cancelled = FALSE AND ds.is_test_store = FALSE
assumptions: A 2025 március a 2025-ös fiskális év első hónapja (fiscal_month = 1)
A nettó árbevétel = bruttó összeg - kedvezmény
Kizárjuk a visszárukat (is_return = FALSE) és a törölt tételeket (is_cancelled = FALSE)
Kizárjuk a teszt üzleteket (is_test_store = FALSE)
Az euróra konvertáláshoz az fx_rate táblát használjuk az eladás dátumának megfelelő árfolyammal

results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fs.receipt_id) AS receipt_count FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.sales_date = dd.date WHERE ds.region_name = 'Dél-Alföld' AND dd.fiscal_year = 2025 AND dd.fiscal_month = 1 AND fs.is_cancelled = FALSE
assumptions: March 2025 refers to fiscal month 1 of fiscal year 2025 (since the fiscal year starts on March 1)
Cancelled receipts are excluded from the count
Test stores are included in the count (no filter on is_test_store)
Both return and regular receipts are counted

assumptions: A 2025 március a 2025-ös fiskális év első hónapja (fiscal_month = 1), mivel a fiskális év március 1-én kezdődik

Az árfolyam konverzió az eladás dátumának megfelelő árfolyamot használja
A teljes lánc összes üzletét beleértjük (nincs szűrés az üzletekre)
